details: The package's postinstall hook runs postinstall.js, which collects extensive system and environment information — hostname, username, working directory, OS/kernel, container detection, process tree, GitHub CI variables (GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_ACTOR, GITHUB_RUN_ID, CI, RUNNER_NAME), IP addresses, DNS servers, cloud metadata probe results (Tencent Cloud and AWS), and the full environment (capturing any tokens, API keys, or credentials). All collected data is base64-encoded and exfiltrated via HTTP GET to pzs5w7ntzhsnepwk564lyfdci3oucl0a[.]oastify[.]com. The package's index.js is a decoy containing harmless color-utility functions.
